title: Re-Booking Allowance When a Self-Pay Visit Package Is Unfrozen
content:
**Scheduling coordinator guidance.** When a Self-Pay Visit Package is unfrozen, the re-booking allowance gives the patient time to rebuild the standing schedule of the Appointment Series the package funds: **7 days** where that series stands at two or more visits per week, **3 days** where it stands at one visit per week, and none otherwise. The allowance is added to the freeze-credit days after the freeze days have been capped, so it is credited in full even where the freeze days reach the cap.

**Schedule ladder**

| Standing visits per week on the Appointment Series linked to the package | Re-booking allowance |
|---|---|
| no series linked, or 0 | none |
| 1 | 3 days |
| 2 | 7 days |
| 3 or more | 7 days |

**Reading note.** The standing visits per week are those shown on the Appointment Series that the package funds.

*Hypothetical:* a package funding a series that stands at 2 visits per week, whose freeze days are capped at 30, has the 7-day allowance added to its 30 capped freeze days, which brings them to 37.
